title: test(verify): the dashboard-window runs freeze Date at noon UTC, pinned from a wall clock 100 ms before midnight
body:
Fixes #23351

Clause-②: no

## What changed

`packages/verify/src/dashboard-window.test.ts` only. The probe (`packages/verify/src/dashboard-window.ts`) is not edited: its day-turn `not-run` is a correct answer and stays as it is. No case is skipped.

- **The freeze.** One helper, `onFrozenClock(run)`, fakes `Date` only (`vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ['Date'] })`; every timer stays real) at noon UTC of the day the run starts on, and gives the real clock back in `finally`. Every `runDashboardWindowProofs` call in the file goes through it.
- **The pin.** `wallClockAtMidnight()` sets the wall clock to 23:59:59.900Z of today, still moving at its real pace (`shouldAdvanceTime: true`, `Date` only). The positive fixture run and both NEGATIVE CONTROL runs start from it, then go through `onFrozenClock`. With the freeze they pass. Without it they cross midnight in their first measure and fail with the day-turn reason on any day, not only on a day whose run crosses 00:00Z (ablation below). The pin is in the file, so it stays, and it costs no extra boot.
- **One spelling.** THE DAY TURN block now uses the same helper instead of its own copy of the fake-`Date` setup. It still moves the clock one day on the run's first door call. It now starts from noon of the start day instead of the real instant.

## Inventory, on `origin/main` 252775d1d

Every case that runs the family and asserts a verdict or reason other than the day turn:

| block | cases | real clock before this PR | what a day turn changes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `runDashboardWindowProofs — the fixture app` | 4, one shared `beforeAll` run | yes | "proves every bound count widget…" asserts `proven`; "counts every dashboard…" asserts `proven: 10`, `notRun: 0` |
| NEGATIVE CONTROL (drop) | 2 | yes | `contradicted`, the `logged_at` rewrite reason, the `audited_at` unconfirmed reason |
| NEGATIVE CONTROL (zero) | 2 | yes | the same; these two went red in merge-queue run 38486827994 |
| THE DAY TURN | 1 | no, already faked `Date` | asserts the day turn itself |
| `deriveDashboardWindowCases` | 2 | no clock read | none |

The freeze sits in each run's `beforeAll`, so it covers all 8 cases of the three runs.

## Mechanism, measured

- The probe reads the clock through `new Date()` only (`dashboard-window.ts` lines 575, 795 and 884). The server resolves the same presets on `new Date()` in this process (`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-executor.ts` line 127, `filterTokenContextFrom(context, new Date())`). So faking `Date` reaches both sides, and the frozen run's presets agree with the server's.
- Timers stay real, so nothing the run waits on stalls. Wall time, the base file against this file, alternated twice, each pair in one lock hold on a shared box (ratios survive the sharing, the absolutes do not):

| pair | this file: wall / vitest `tests` | base file: wall / vitest `tests` | ratio, `tests` |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | 38.5 s / 13.55 s | 41.1 s / 13.41 s | 1.01 |
| B | 43.1 s / 14.74 s | 41.6 s / 13.42 s | 1.10 |

## Ablation, and a one-shot check of the other side of noon

Both legs went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit, blob checked) inside a script with its own `trap` restore. Both were restored to the HEAD blob `49740f917f02` with `git diff HEAD` empty. No mutation file is left.

- **Freeze removed, wall clock at 23:59:59.900Z.** The two `onFrozenClock` lines that fake and set `Date` are replaced. Anchor 1 → 0, blob `49740f917f02` → `4d765d5b68a4`; on disk the freeze anchor counts 0 and the injected marker 1. Result: `Tests 6 failed | 5 passed (11)`. The failures are the positive run's "proves every bound count widget…" and "counts every dashboard…", plus all four NEGATIVE CONTROL cases. Every measure reads `inconclusive: the day turned after the run started (2026-10-15 → 2026-10-16) …` or `the day turned during the probe …`. The ATTRIBUTION case fails with `expected 'the day turned after the run started …' to match /reads back logged_at = "2020-01-01T00…/`, which is run 38486827994's signature, now on demand. THE DAY TURN, the two derive cases and the two positive cases a day turn does not change stay green.
- **Frozen at noon of the previous day.** This is about 13 h before the session's real sign-in: the other side of the noon-versus-now offset this suite meets over a day. At 01:2xZ today's noon is about 10.5 h ahead. Anchor 1 → 0, blob → `9336e35e133d`. Result: `Tests 11 passed (11)`. A frozen instant hours away from the real boot, in either direction, does not change a verdict.

## Tests and gates, all at `c9e7b172f`

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/dashboard-window.test.ts`: `Tests 11 passed (11)`, three runs: the verbose run and the fixed-file leg of each timing pair. Before the edit, at 252775d1d: `Tests 11 passed (11)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify typecheck`: exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit`, then `check:test-typecheck`: 0 errors). `tsc --listFiles -p tsconfig.test.json` holds `dashboard-window.test.ts` (1 of the 41 test files in the program).
- eslint over `packages/verify` with `--no-inline-config`: exit 0. 59 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, and the target file was linted. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 50 commands, each run with its exit code recorded before any pipe. `--ran` reports 50 derived, 49 run (all exit 0), 1 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun. The NOT MEASURED one is `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET. It reads every package's `dist/` and needs a whole-workspace `pnpm build`. This diff changes no built output, and CI runs it.
- `skip-changeset`, by its criterion. `files[]` is `dist`, `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`. After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify build`, `onFrozenClock` and `wallClockAtMidnight` hit 0 files there, while the positive control `runDashboardWindowProofs` hits 4.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/cli/test/verify-dashboard-windows.test.ts` runs the same family through a spawned `os verify --dashboard-windows` child on the real clock. It asserts `proven` and `contradicted`, so a run that crosses 00:00Z would read `not-run` there too. `vi.useFakeTimers` cannot reach a child process, so the fix there is not this mechanical edit, and that file is outside this card's file surface. This is a read-only inference and has not been measured red. Carrier: none.
- Inside a frozen run the structured logger stamps every line `12:00:00.000Z`, because it reads `Date` too. Log times there are not wall time.
- `origin/main` gained 3 commits after the base (hono adapter, metadata-protocol, objectql tests). None touches `packages/verify`, and there is no conflict, so they are not merged in.
